text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need to decide semantics for /embeddings when clients send mixed-dim vectors in one request. Current API rejects; several customers asked for convenience. Thoughts?

Arjun Patel: +1 on ergonomics, but curious about perf and billing complexity.

Kevin O'Leary: Two reasonable server-side strategies: 1) coerce (pad/truncate) — terrible for quality; 2) split-and-route per-dim and reassemble — preserves quality but adds scheduling work. I prefer split-and-route.

Maria Chen: Proposal: accept mixed dims, server splits into per-dim batches, routes each batch to the right model/kernel, and reassembles results in original order. Add opt-in header `X-Embeddings-Split: true` for canary.

Samir Gupta: Billing/quotas: we should bill per-vector compute (i.e., dimension-weighted) and count vectors toward per-request quotas. Example: 2x1536 + 3x768 => bill 2*1536 + 3*768 compute-units. Also enforce per-call payload byte limit. Need clear docs so customers don't get surprised.

Lisa Tran: Telemetry we need: `embedding_split_count`, `embedding_split_rate`, `split_batch_size_{dim}`, `split_latency_ms_p50/p95`, and tag `routing_policy=split|reject`. Also track reassembly errors.

Arjun Patel: Perf note — splitting introduces overhead (extra queueing, multiple kernel warmups). We should gate split behavior by thresholds: max_vectors_for_split (default 10) and max_payload_bytes (default 1_000_000). Above that return 413 with a helpful message.

Kevin O'Leary: Console UX — surface a per-route metric for split_rate and per-dim throughput. Add a small banner when split mode is enabled: "Mixed-dim splitting enabled — metric: split_rate". Rollout knob should be a feature flag `emb_split_v1` with % rollout.

Maria Chen: Rollout plan: start opt-in header for customers, then 5% platform traffic for 48h, collect p95 latency, cost delta, reassembly error rate. If OK, increase to 25% then global.

deploy-bot: deploy 1772681300 embeddings-service:feature/emb-split -> canary

Samir Gupta: SDKs + OpenAPI: we need examples showing original order preserved and how billing appears in usage. Also update quota enforcement docs. Small sample: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "text-embed-002",
  "input": ["short", "longer text", "tiny"]
}
# server may split by dimensions internally and return vectors in the original order
```

Kevin O'Leary: Schema debate — do we add per-item metadata (dimensions) in request? I vote no — keep the request model unchanged, just accept arrays and infer dims from model input/embedding output. Adding per-item schema is a big breaking change.

Lisa Tran: Alerts: create a pager/alert if `split_rate > 30%` AND `split_latency_p95 > baseline_p95 * 2`. Also alert on `reassembly_error_rate > 0.01%`.

Arjun Patel: For the initial rollout let's default to REJECT and require the opt-in header. That reduces surprise and makes telemetry clean. Any objections?

Maria Chen: No objections. Action items: I'll open server PR (split logic + reassembly + opt-in header). Kevin, can you own console tiles and rollout UI? Samir, billing + docs. Lisa, metrics + alerts. Arjun, perf testing harness.

Kevin O'Leary: Assigned, will add dashboard widgets and a "split mode" toggle in the per-route settings.

Samir Gupta: I'll update pricing.md and quota enforcement, and add a usage-sample in the SDKs.

Lisa Tran: I'll add telemetry instrumentation to the embedding pipeline and create the alert runbook.

Arjun Patel: I'll set up perf jobs (canary harness) and run latency/cost comparisons.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link when ready.

deploy-bot: canary started 1772683320 — traffic 5% for feature/emb-split

Kevin O'Leary: ack
